newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE RECOVERS WITH GOOD BUYING INTEREST.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE RECOVERS WITH GOOD BUYING INTEREST.

text.p: Key banking stocks recovered on Friday as buying pressure picked up after several days of falling prices and profit-taking, dealers said
The rise is expected to continue into the next week, but dealers see another drop possible late in the week.
Total trade on the main list was 155 million kroons as the Talse index gained 3.60 percent to end the week at 418.06.
"There were buyers active in most shares during the day with interest in banking stocks the strongest," one trader said.
Hansapank was the most active stock with 76 million kroons traded to gain 2.50 kroons for a close of 219.50 kroons, six percent lower than last Friday's close.
Spectulative interest in Uhispank pushed it to 105 kroons, a rise of 10.25 kroons with 24.7 million kroons traded.
On the free market, total trade was 5.4 million kroons with privatisation vouchers the most active.
Privatisation securities were down to 0.416 kroons from 0.44 kroons with 3.6 million kroons traded.
